svg.title: What a line between two stars means
svg.desc: Four kinds of relation on the demand map: a solid line means one phrase literally contains the other and is read from the text; a firm dotted line means the two were proved to be the same door by comparing real search results; a light dotted line means the same field but a different room; and no line at all means either nobody proposed the pair or it was checked and cut, so silence is not a verdict.
svg.text: read straight from the words, nothing to prove
two different phrasings that turned out to lead
to the same set of real search results
the same field, a different room
related work, but people looking for one
do not end up finding the other
either nobody has proposed the pair yet, or it
was checked and cut. Silence is not a verdict —
every star says which of the two it is.
